limitations: Synthetic simulation evidence; not real utility measurements.
The accepted historical artifact stored 18 batch-cell summaries; these episode rows and intervals were regenerated from the audited simulator and frozen PPO checkpoint.
Paired bootstrap intervals quantify variability under the fixed synthetic scenario design, not a field causal effect.
Results describe one frozen PPO actor checkpoint and deterministic inference.

available_mwh.definition: Sum of available system supply over 24 one-hour steps.

critical_outage_locality_hours.definition: Locality-hours with critical-sector service below 99 percent.

critical_service_ratio.definition: Served critical-sector energy divided by critical-sector demand.

curtailed_mwh.definition: Demand minus dispatched energy over 24 one-hour steps.

demand_mwh.definition: Sum of simulated system demand over 24 one-hour steps.

episode_reward.definition: Sum of the accepted 24 hourly reward values.

fairness.definition: Mean hourly Jain fairness of cumulative locality service ratios.

oversubscription.definition: Mean hourly positive requested-power excess divided by demand.

power_balance_violation_rate.definition: Fraction of hours served power exceeds supply by more than 1e-3 MW.

served_mwh.definition: Sum of dispatched energy over 24 one-hour steps.

switching_rate.definition: Mean hourly fraction of localities changing service tier; the initial hour is zero.

utilization.definition: Mean hourly served power divided by min(available supply, demand).

bootstrap.method: deterministic seed-stratified paired cluster percentile bootstrap

protocol.count_statement: 96 independent base draws crossed with 3 shortage levels = 288 matched scenario conditions; 576 controller-scenario evaluations (288 per controller).
